signal: GovDash raised a $30M Series B in January 2026 (led by Mucker and BCI) after 16x revenue growth and 18x customer growth to nearly 200 companies

email.body1:
Cydney, saw GovDash closed a $30M Series B after 16x revenue growth and scaling to nearly 200 customers.

Growing that fast generates buying signals faster than most ops teams can route them, so good-fit accounts sit untouched and data goes stale. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, followed-up outreach with zero human time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, every touch auto-logged to your CRM.

I built a signal play for GovDash off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Cydney, quick follow-up for GovDash.

At 16x growth, the lift is usually hiding in faster signal-to-action and cleaner follow-up, but it is hard to see exactly where the process leaks. Our built-in best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change to tighten the signal-to-meeting path.
email.body3:
Cydney, last bit of proof for GovDash.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how GovDash's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Cydney, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling ops through 16x growth is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to GovDash either way.
